canonical.meaning: An invitation was created. The fact is the native acceptance of the invitation's logical id on the invitation stream and freezes the exact recipient, purpose, scopes and expiry. The bearer token never enters the fact, only its hash and the key that derives it. MailboxGeneration is the generation of the mailbox claim the invitation was published under; only that generation may release it. GuestProgramIdsManifest references the complete ordered program scope.
